What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[A Brave Resistance]]: left, the image of [[A Brave Resistance (Errata 4)]] (holotable commit 88182de); right, the image of [[A Brave Resistance (Errata 5)]] (holotable commit 6f23e07). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/88182de5459f1ffeeb3856f4ece24e2f4c6a7437/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
